title: Apple isn't just building a new campus in Austin. Here's everywhere the tech giant is expanding. (AAPL)
text: ▶ Apple Is Planning To Build A Billion Dollar Facility In Austin, TX 00:33 Apple is establishing a new campus in Austin, Texas. The campus will initially house 5,000 employees. Apple is going to spend $1 billion building it. Austin, Texas was recently in the running for Amazon's second headquarters, HQ2. Roles based at the building will include engineering, R&D, operations,... Recent related videos from verified sources Apple Will Create a $1 Billion Campus in Austin, TX Austin is already home to an Apple campus which accommodates 6,200 employees. The new campus is planned to be erected across 133 acres, less.. Credit: Wibbitz Top Stories - Published 3 hours ago The company announced Thursday the 133-acre campus will employ 5,000 new workers.
